title: Briscola
subtitle: Italian classic trick-taking — 40-card deck, no must-follow

message.yourTurn: Your turn — any card is playable (no must-follow)
message.trickComplete: Trick complete — advance to the next

tutorial.trump: The card laid sideways under the stock is the trump (briscola). Its suit beats every other suit.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the table. Win with a higher card of the same suit, or any trump (no must-follow).
tutorial.hand: Your hand — click a card to play it. Briscola scores differently: A = 11, 3 = 10.
tutorial.score: Tricks, stock left, and points. The deck totals 120 points; reach 61 to win.
